svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin flat oxide lies on a dotted glass that buries two active areas, an oxide-filled trench with a wide stack on it and a narrow capped gate. After it resist covers the flat surface except three openings: one over each active area and one over the middle of the wide stack.

svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the contact
reticle and developed, opening the contact holes.
After: resist with three contact openings
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
